verses.original: Παῦλος καὶ Σιλουανὸς καὶ Τιμόθεος Τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ Θεσσαλονικέων ἐν Θεῷ ἡμῶν Πατρὶ καὶ Κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ Χριστῷ
verses.transliteration: Paulos kai Silouanos kai Timotheos Tē ekklēsia Thessalonikeōn en Theō hēmōn Patri kai Kyriō Iēsou Christō
verses.literal: Paul - Silvanus and Timothy To the church of [the] Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ

verses.original: Χάρις καὶ εἰρήνη ὑμῖν ἀπὸ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν Πατρὸς καὶ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: Charis kai eirēnē hymin apo Theou hēmōn Patros kai Kyriou Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ

verses.original: ὀφείλομεν Εὐχαριστεῖν τῷ Θεῷ περὶ ὑμῶν πάντοτε ἀδελφοί καθὼς ἐστιν ἄξιόν ὅτι ὑμῶν ἡ πίστις ὑπεραυξάνει καὶ ἑνὸς ἑκάστου πάντων ὑμῶν ἡ ἀγάπη εἰς ἀλλήλους πλεονάζει
verses.transliteration: opheilomen Eucharistein tō Theō peri hymōn pantote adelphoi kathōs estin axion hoti hymōn hē pistis hyperauxanei kai henos hekastou pantōn hymōn hē agapē eis allēlous pleonazei
verses.literal: We are obligated to thank - God for you all the time brothers as is fitting because your - faith is growing more and more and vvv vvv vvv your - love for one another is increasing

verses.original: ὥστε ἡμᾶς αὐτοὺς ἐνκαυχᾶσθαι ἐν τοῦ Θεοῦ ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις ἐν ὑμῖν ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν τῆς ὑπομονῆς καὶ πίστεως ἐν πᾶσιν ὑμῶν τοῖς διωγμοῖς καὶ ταῖς θλίψεσιν αἷς ἀνέχεσθε
verses.transliteration: hōste hēmas autous enkauchasthai en tou Theou tais ekklēsiais en hymin hyper hymōn tēs hypomonēs kai pisteōs en pasin hymōn tois diōgmois kai tais thlipsesin hais anechesthe
verses.literal: That is why we - boast among - God’s - churches - - about your - perseverance and faith in the face of all [the] - persecution and - affliction - you are enduring

verses.original: Ἔνδειγμα τῆς τοῦ Θεοῦ δικαίας κρίσεως τὸ εἰς ὑμᾶς καταξιωθῆναι τῆς βασιλείας τοῦ Θεοῦ ὑπὲρ ἧς καὶ πάσχετε
verses.transliteration: Endeigma tēs tou Theou dikaias kriseōs to eis hymas kataxiōthēnai tēs basileias tou Theou hyper hēs kai paschete
verses.literal: [ All this is ] clear evidence - - of God’s righteous judgment - And so you will be counted worthy of the kingdom - of God for which - you are suffering

verses.original: εἴπερ δίκαιον παρὰ Θεῷ ἀνταποδοῦναι θλῖψιν τοῖς θλίβουσιν ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: eiper dikaion para Theō antapodounai thlipsin tois thlibousin hymas
verses.literal: After all [it is] only right for God to repay with affliction those who afflict you

verses.original: καὶ ἄνεσιν ὑμῖν τοῖς θλιβομένοις μεθ’ ἡμῶν ἐν τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ τῇ ἀποκαλύψει ἀπ’ οὐρανοῦ μετ’ αὐτοῦ δυνάμεως ἀγγέλων
verses.transliteration: kai anesin hymin tois thlibomenois meth’ hēmōn en tou Kyriou Iēsou tē apokalypsei ap’ ouranou met’ autou dynameōs angelōn
verses.literal: and to grant relief to you who are oppressed and to us [as well] [This will take place when] the Lord Jesus - is revealed from heaven with His mighty angels

verses.original: ἐν φλογός πυρὶ διδόντος ἐκδίκησιν τοῖς μὴ εἰδόσιν Θεὸν καὶ τοῖς μὴ ὑπακούουσιν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ ἡμῶν τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: en phlogos pyri didontos ekdikēsin tois mē eidosin Theon kai tois mē hypakouousin tō euangeliō hēmōn tou Kyriou Iēsou
verses.literal: in blazing fire inflicting vengeance on those who vvv do not know God and - vvv do not obey the gospel of our - Lord Jesus

verses.original: οἵτινες τίσουσιν δίκην αἰώνιον ὄλεθρον ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ Κυρίου καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς δόξης τῆς αὐτοῦ ἰσχύος
verses.transliteration: hoitines tisousin dikēn aiōnion olethron apo prosōpou tou Kyriou kai apo tēs doxēs tēs autou ischyos
verses.literal: [They] will suffer [the] penalty of eternal destruction separated from [the] presence of the Lord and - the glory of His might

verses.original: ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ὅταν ἔλθῃ ἐνδοξασθῆναι ἐν αὐτοῦ τοῖς ἁγίοις καὶ θαυμασθῆναι ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς πιστεύσασιν ὅτι ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς ἐπιστεύθη ἡμῶν τὸ μαρτύριον
verses.transliteration: en ekeinē tē hēmera hotan elthē endoxasthēnai en autou tois hagiois kai thaumasthēnai en pasin tois pisteusasin hoti eph’ hymas episteuthē hēmōn to martyrion
verses.literal: on [the] - day - He comes to be glorified in His - saints and regarded with wonder by all who have believed including - you who have believed our - testimony

verses.original: Εἰς ὃ καὶ προσευχόμεθα πάντοτε περὶ ὑμῶν ἵνα ἡμῶν ὁ Θεὸς ὑμᾶς ἀξιώσῃ τῆς κλήσεως καὶ ἐν δυνάμει πληρώσῃ πᾶσαν ἀγαθωσύνης εὐδοκίαν καὶ ἔργον πίστεως
verses.transliteration: Eis ho kai proseuchometha pantote peri hymōn hina hēmōn ho Theos hymas axiōsē tēs klēseōs kai en dynamei plērōsē pasan agathōsynēs eudokian kai ergon pisteōs
verses.literal: To this end . . . . . . we always pray . . . for you that our - God vvv will count you worthy of [His] calling and [that] vvv vvv He will powerfully fulfill [your] every good desire and work of faith

verses.original: ὅπως τὸ ὄνομα ἡμῶν τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ ἐνδοξασθῇ ἐν ὑμῖν καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐν αὐτῷ κατὰ τὴν χάριν ἡμῶν τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: hopōs to onoma hēmōn tou Kyriou Iēsou endoxasthē en hymin kai hymeis en autō kata tēn charin hēmōn tou Theou kai Kyriou Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: so that the name of our - Lord Jesus will be glorified in you and you in Him according to the grace of our - God and of [the] Lord Jesus Christ
